decisions: Checkout is seamless and account-linked; no voucher or promo-code issuance flow
Primary checkout rails are USDC and PYUSD on Arbitrum; PYUSD on Ethereum remains a hidden fallback and USDC on Base remains the visible generic crypto-wallet route
The client may request a named rail, but the server maps it to fixed asset, network, chain, and token metadata
Every intent receives a unique address derived from a watch-only account xpub
The cruush application and server never receive a seed phrase, private key, or raw card data
Wallet custody is temporarily software-only in Julien's current macOS user until his hardware wallet arrives
A local operator tool may handle recovery words transiently through a normal interactive Terminal, but never stores them, accepts them through arguments or environment variables, or deploys them
Initial transaction signing is limited to Base Sepolia and never broadcasts
Settlement evidence is chain logs read by the server; a browser poll, copied address, or member-supplied transaction hash is never evidence
The entitlement grant is shared with the existing checkout path through grantCruushPlusPlan, so the two cannot drift
Grant idempotency is enforced by database constraints, not only by application logic
Settlement policy values are engineering defaults standing in for product decisions and need Julien's sign-off
The watcher starts only when the processor is enabled, the watcher is enabled, and a chain endpoint is configured
cruush does not offer voluntary cruush+ refunds except where law requires a withdrawal, refund, remedy, or forced reversal; cruush+ is treated as an ongoing interactive digital service
The refunded payment state is unreachable record-keeping only, kept so an exceptional hand-made refund can be recorded truthfully

EU/EEA sales remain blocked until service-withdrawal compliance and jurisdiction-specific legal review are complete, or those consumers are excluded server-side; an immediate-performance checkbox alone does not remove the 14-day service withdrawal right
Arbitrum is the primary rail: it is the only network Cash App, Venmo, and PayPal can all send to, and its fees are negligible where mainnet charges per sale forever
The checkout asks which app someone is paying from, never which chain or coin
The Other payment options label is removed because it does not identify a useful crypto choice; the underlying payment controls remain
Julien explicitly authorized creating the software wallet in the current julienlenaz macOS user on 2026-09-01

Recovery words and private keys remain user-only: the agent may prepare and launch initialization but must stop before the live-presence response and never inspect, capture, copy, store, or transmit the secret display
Migration 101 gives every payment intent a durable origin and cursor on every supported chain and adds authoritative transfer block timestamps
Every active watcher scan verifies chain ID before the head or logs; settlement validates each candidate block number and hash, then re-sums locked pre-expiry exact-rail evidence before grant
Transfers mined after expires_at never grant; scheduler expiry does not invalidate an exact-rail transfer authoritatively timestamped at or before expires_at while it finishes confirming

Active lifetime access blocks every new crypto purchase; a successful shared lifetime grant atomically closes pending and awaiting-payment crypto intents while preserving confirming intents with observed funds
The confirmed-money reconciliation threshold matches settlement at 50 basis points capped at 250000 atomic units ($0.25) and counts only the intent's exact rail
A restored crypto intent keeps its original source and locked selectors through paid even when that rail is unavailable
Only origin/feat/crypto-pricing may be updated; main and production remain forbidden

assumptions.statement: Arbitrum's public RPC endpoint is the current zero-cost read-only source; it has no availability guarantee.
assumptions.impact: A paid provider remains a one-variable swap if reliability or rate limits require it.

assumptions.statement: Confirmation targets, underpayment tolerance, and overpayment flag thresholds remain engineering defaults requiring owner sign-off. Transfers mined after quote expiry never auto-grant; scheduler timing does not invalidate a transfer mined before expiry.
assumptions.impact: These decide when chain evidence counts as paid. Funds mined after expiry remain evidence for owner review until treatment after a price change is explicitly selected.

assumptions.statement: cruush+ is an ongoing digital service. An immediate-performance request does not eliminate the EU/EEA service withdrawal right before full performance.
assumptions.impact: EU/EEA launch needs a compliant withdrawal flow and legal review, or server-side exclusion of those consumers.
